title: Fassi Chicken
description: Tender, slow-simmered chicken infused with aromatic ginger, garlic, and precious saffron. Finished with luscious preserved lemon confit strips, warm herbs, and vibrant green olives for a bright, savory flavor balance rooted in Moroccan tradition.

title: L'ham bel Barkouk
description: Succulent, melt-in-your-mouth beef braised in warming spices, cinnamon, and saffron threads. Elegantly crowned with sweet caramelized prunes, whole crunchy toasted almonds, delicate almond flakes, and a fine dusting of powdered sugar—a classic celebration of Moroccan savory-sweet harmony.

title: Ghriba Louz
description: Handcrafted Moroccan almond cookies infused with orange blossom water, baked to perfection with a soft, chewy center and a delicate dusting of powdered sugar.

title: Traditional Moroccan Almond Shakedown
description: A blend of fine almond paste and fragrant orange blossom water. Made to order your way: with creamy milk, or dairy-free with water.
